# `/review`

> Review a completed feature against its spec. Auto-detects the feature if no argument given.

<!-- generated by scripts/gen-command-docs.py from commands/review.md — do not edit -->

Independent review by `spec-reviewer` and `quality-reviewer` in parallel, merged into `review.md` with a mechanical verdict.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Usage** | `/review [feature-name]` |
| **Reads** | `spec.md`, `plan.md`, `tasks.md`, constitution, PRD, `DESIGN.md` |
| **Writes** | `review.md`; spec status → Complete if OK |
| **Gates** | Verdict: Ready to merge / Pass with notes / Needs work. On Needs work it can append corrective tasks. |
| **Next** | `/qa` then `/ship` |
| **Tools** | `Bash, Read, Write, Edit, Grep, Glob, Agent, EnterWorktree` |
